emotional_tone: High-end, architectural, mysterious, hyper-focused, cinematic, spatial, tactile
context_type: Marketing Page & Immersive Architectural SaaS Application

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-serif uppercase

layout_and_grids.surface_strategy: Glassmorphism with optical saturation (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10) for floating headers, drawers, search and dark room simulator control panel.

loading_sequence.scene_1: Black space with ambient particle system drifting at low velocity and faint radial gradient glow.
loading_sequence.scene_2: VINKRI building facade emerges with blur-to-clear opacity fade and 2.5D scale transition from 90% to 100%.
loading_sequence.scene_3: 3D/2.5D building rotation (270°–360°) simulating an architectural model in a studio lighting cage.
loading_sequence.scene_4: Volumetric light sweep across window glass panes and stone textures highlighting facade geometry.
loading_sequence.scene_5: Typography reveal: VINKRI followed by VIRTUAL STUDIO with wide letter tracking.
loading_sequence.scene_6: ENTER STUDIO button with subtle breathing glow pulse. Click triggers camera push-through effect into studio interior.

building_facade.parallax_layers: Foreground dust particles -> Building body -> Windows/Apertures -> Architectural labels -> Background skybox glow.
building_facade.floor_hover_vfx: Hovered floor glides forward (+12px Z transform), window apertures illuminate with warm/cool light, vertical light beam casts behind floor.
building_facade.floor_click: Selected floor brightens, non-selected floors dim to 20% opacity, camera zooms straight into selected floor portal.

studio_floors.name: LIGHT LAB
studio_floors.vfx: Warm and cool light gradients, interactive floating photons, animated architectural lamps, realtime reflections.

studio_floors.name: SACRED ROOM
studio_floors.vfx: Candle-like ambient warm light, circular light halos, atmospheric haze, slow floating dust particles.

studio_floors.name: MEMORY ARCHIVE
studio_floors.vfx: Floating paper/blueprint fragments, film grain overlay, slow horizontal drift, archived catalog tags.

studio_floors.name: OBJECT LIBRARY
studio_floors.vfx: Precision CAD blueprint grid overlays, floating object silhouettes, architectural measurement lines, dimension callouts.

dark_room_simulator.concept: Interactive virtual dark room testing chamber where users adjust room darkness (0% to 100%) and product luminous intensity (lumens/kelvin).
features: Room Darkness Slider (Daylight / Dusk / Midnight Vault)
Product Beam Brightness / Dimmer (100 lm to 3500 lm)
Color Temperature Control (2700K Warm Gold to 6500K Arctic Daylight)
Live Lux Foot-Candle Meter Display & Wall Surface Glow Projection
Before/After Split View & Shadow Angle Simulator

product_card_vfx.magnetic_cursor: Cards subtly shift towards cursor position within 150px proximity.
product_card_vfx.hover_state: Lift 3D tilt transform, expanded shadow layer, metadata slides in from bottom edge.
product_card_vfx.expansion_modal: Shared element transition where product card expands smooth into central detail modal without full page reload.

motion_architecture.cart_fly_vfx: On clicking 'ADD TO TROLLEY', product thumbnail shrinks into a glowing orb particle that curves through 3D space toward top-right trolley icon, triggering trolley scale bounce.

custom_cursor.interactive_states: VIEW OBJECT on cards, ENTER FLOOR on building facade, DRAG on marquee conveyor, ADJUST on dark room sliders.

architectural_interiors.description: Dimly lit stone architectural corridor with embedded wall wash lighting
Minimalist dark interior living space with accent spotlighting

general_guidelines.data_testid_policy: All buttons, sliders, links, inputs, floor selectors, modals, and trolley elements MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='enter-studio-button', data-testid='floor-card-01', data-testid='dark-room-dimmer-slider').
general_guidelines.accessibility: Full prefers-reduced-motion support via Framer Motion useReducedMotion hook to disable camera push-through and particles while preserving state transitions.
general_guidelines.theme_transition: Radial gradient wipe originating from light/dark theme toggle button expanding across viewport.
